title: 第一卷 第15章 这个炉鼎疯了吧第一卷 第16章 主人奴家来了哦
slug: 百岁成魔开局拿捏妖女命脉
content_zh:

几天后，李寒山再度进入了梦境。
这梦境怎么来的他还不太清楚，在间隔的时间上有长有短，一般在一个多月一次，最长的一次隔了三个月，具体的规律他还没有摸清楚。
河边，青石依旧，流水潺潺。
但这一次，洛璃不在。
李寒山等了许久，仍不见她的身影。
“丫头说她要闭关，不会真的闭关了吧？”
他正想着，前方空气突然泛起涟漪，洛璃跌跌撞撞地走出来。
“丫头！你怎么了？”
李寒山吓了一跳，连忙上前扶住她。
“没事没事~”
洛璃摆摆手：“修炼得太投入，差点错过了大爷的梦，还好赶上了。”
李寒山看着她疲惫的样子，心中一阵酸涩。
“丫头，你不用每次都来的，修炼要紧。”
“那可不行。”
洛璃摇摇头，认真道：“万一大爷遇到危险怎么办？我得来看看。”
她在李寒山旁边的石头上坐下，问：“大爷，最近情况怎么样？”
李寒山将这些天发生的事一五一十地说了。
洛璃听完，蹙着眉头思索片刻，道：“既然这样，大爷就先去参加秘境试炼吧。不过要小心，那妖女肯定有后手或者什么针对大爷的杀招。”
李寒山点头：“我知道。”

“对了。”
洛璃突然想起什么，眼睛一亮：“大爷，我再教你一门御剑诀。这门剑诀非常厉害，学会之后，越级战斗不成问题。”
“越级战斗？”
李寒山大喜。
他现在炼气八层巅峰，如果能越级战斗，那就能跟炼气九、十层相抗衡了。
“嗯！”
洛璃点点头，伸出纤纤玉指，在半空中书写起来。
一个个古朴的文字浮现，如流光般在虚空中排布开来。
“此剑名流光剑诀，非世间凡品，乃上古快剑一脉所传。”
她轻声道，“剑出不留痕，光至已分生死。不求刚猛霸道，只修一个‘绝速’。”
李寒山凝神望去，只见那篆文排布成剑势轨迹：
起手引气成锋，凝光于剑尖三寸；
行剑如流光掠空，步随身转，剑随身走；
收剑时灵光归鞘，不留半分余劲。
通篇剑意，尽在“瞬至、破空、无痕”六字。
“此剑无固定招式，唯快不破。以神识驱动，若运用得当，炼气亦可斩筑基，同境之中，无人能接你第二剑。”
洛璃话音落下，漫天篆文骤然化作一道清光，径直涌入李寒山识海。
刹那间，剑理、剑诀、剑势，尽数烙印在他神魂深处。
“丫头，你这一手好厉害。”
李寒山赞叹，这省去了他埋头苦记的烦恼。

A few days later, Li Hanshan entered dreamland again.
He wasn't quite sure how this dream came about. The intervals varied, usually once every month or so, and the longest one was three months apart. He hadn't figured out the specific pattern yet.
By the river, the bluestones remain the same and the water flows.
But this time, Luo Li wasn't there.
Li Hanshan waited for a long time, but still didn't see her.
"The girl said she was going into seclusion. Is she really going into seclusion?"
Just as he was thinking, the air in front of him suddenly rippled, and Luo Li stumbled out.
"Girl! What's wrong with you?"
Li Hanshan was startled and quickly stepped forward to support her.
"It's okay, it's okay~"
Luo Li waved her hand: "I was too devoted to practice and almost missed the uncle's dream, but luckily I caught up."
Li Hanshan felt sour in his heart when he looked at her tired look.
"Girl, you don't have to come every time. It's important to practice."
"That's not okay."
Luo Li shook her head and said seriously: "What if the uncle is in danger? I have to come and take a look."
She sat down on the stone next to Li Hanshan and asked, "Uncle, how are things going lately?"
Li Hanshan told everything that happened these days.
After hearing this, Luo Li frowned and thought for a moment, then said: "In this case, let's go to the secret realm trial first. But be careful, the demon girl must have a back-up plan or some killer move against the uncle."
Li Hanshan nodded: "I know."
"Right."
Luo Li suddenly remembered something and her eyes lit up: "Uncle, I will teach you another sword-controlling technique. This sword-controlling technique is very powerful. Once you learn it, fighting beyond the next level will not be a problem."
"Leap-level combat?"
Li Hanshan was overjoyed.
He is now at the peak of the eighth level of Qi refining. If he can fight beyond the level, he can compete with the ninth or tenth level of Qi refining.
"Yeah!"
Luo Li nodded, stretched out her slender jade fingers, and started writing in mid-air.
Ancient words emerged one by one, arranged in the void like streams of light.
"This sword is famous in the Light Sword Technique. It is not an ordinary thing in the world. It is passed down from the ancient line of fast swords."
She said softly, "The sword leaves no mark when it comes out, and the light is enough to distinguish life and death. Don't seek to be strong and domineering, just practice 'extreme speed'."
Li Hanshan looked intently and saw the seal characters arranged in a sword trajectory:
Use your hand to draw the energy into a sharp edge, and condense the light into the three inches of the sword tip;
The movement of the sword is like a stream of light passing through the sky, the steps follow and the sword follows;
When sheathing the sword, the spiritual light returns to its sheath, leaving no trace of energy left.
The meaning of the sword throughout this article is contained in the six words "instantaneous, piercing the sky, and leaving no trace".
"This sword has no fixed moves, except that it is fast and indestructible. It is driven by divine consciousness, and if used properly, it can also cut down the foundation by refining Qi. No one in the same situation can pick up your second sword."
After Luo Li finished speaking, the seal characters all over the sky suddenly turned into a clear light, pouring straight into Li Hanshan's sea of consciousness.
In an instant, the sword principles, sword tactics, and sword power were all imprinted deep in his soul.
"Girl, your skills are so good."
Li Hanshan praised that this saved him the trouble of immersing himself in memorizing.
